description: Move one job card exactly one step: open, in_progress, done, invoiced, archived, stamping the date and an optional note into its history. A skipped or backwards step is refused and nothing is written. Archiving a finished job frees a free-tier slot.

card.description: The job card id, e.g. JC-2026-0003, or the client name when only one card has it

date.description: The date to stamp the step with, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

status.description: The next step for this card: open, in_progress, done, invoiced, archived. in-progress is accepted too

name: job_card_update_status
title: Move a job card one step
